members.member:
Opens the device with the specified identifier asynchronous or returns an already opened handler. Thrown when the requested operation is invalid. The user who locks the device (e.g. BAS 3.x @ localhost). (Optional) The status callback which is called to update the status of the device programming. (Optional) The status callback which is called to update the status of the internal calibration. (Optional) If set to true the programming will be enforced. (Optional) Set to true to perform the initialization in the background. (Optional) The task pipeline. Null to use the default pipeline. (Optional) Information describing the log. A measurement task handler will be returned.
